name: Vaughan

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a green single-story home with a gray shingle roof|A paved driveway leads from the street to a parking area in front of the house|Dense mature trees surround the structure on multiple sides|A wooden fence runs along portions of the front boundary.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence is heavily screened by dense mature trees|Portions of the gray roof and green exterior are visible through the canopy|Open ground is limited by the tree cover and vegetation.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back of the green home partially visible through dense trees and vegetation|A wooden fence and landscaped areas are present|Tree coverage limits clear views of the full rear elevation.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side elevation of the green home with a gray roof and brick chimney|Dense trees and vegetation surround this side|A wooden fence runs along the property edge|Outdoor items and plantings are visible near the structure.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads from the street to a parking area in front of the residence. Dense mature trees surround the house on all sides and limit visibility and sightlines. Open space near the driveway provides some room for emergency vehicle staging. The property is located in a residential area with road frontage. Heavy tree cover may impact movement around the sides and rear of the structure.
